name: FOIA Records Request
summary: Request for the client's immigration file (A-file) and records. USCIS takes requests through its online FIRST system; Form G-639 is optional for paper requests. Other agencies (CBP, ICE, OBIM, EOIR, FBI, State) need separate requests.
instructionsNote: No FOIA instructions were in the reference set. Confirm the USCIS FIRST process and G-639 edition on uscis.gov/records before relying on this preset.

forms.title: Freedom of Information/Privacy Act Request (optional paper form)
forms.note: Online FIRST request is the usual route. The demo prints a request summary for staff to enter online.

filing.where: USCIS FIRST online system (first.uscis.gov) or by mail as shown on uscis.gov/records.
filing.fee: USCIS charges no fee for most FOIA requests; verify on uscis.gov/records.

questions.label: Which agencies? (USCIS, CBP, ICE, OBIM, EOIR, FBI, State)

checklist.label: Signed verification of identity or consent (staff prepare it; you sign)
checklist.help: A notarized statement or a statement under penalty of perjury.
